proof_scope: Generate a source-bound coverage report from actual pytest JUnit results; reject stale/tampered run evidence.

claims.proves: Every recorded security case maps once to the explicit catalog and totals reconcile; changed JUnit bytes are refused.
claims.does_not_prove: Coverage sufficiency, privacy guarantees, clean Docker qualification, or human report approval.

cases.name: report-from-real-security-run
command: cd .. && w=$(mktemp -d "$QUALIFICATION_ROOT/report-XXXXXX") && python3 scripts/report_test_coverage.py --junit security/reports/adversarial-coverage/security-junit.xml --run security/reports/adversarial-coverage/test-run.json --output "$w" && python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]+"/inventory.json")); assert sum(f["total"] for f in r["families"]) == r["case_count"]; assert len({x["nodeid"] for x in r["cases"]}) == r["case_count"]; print("RECONCILED")' "$w"

cases.name: tampered-junit-refused
command: cd .. && w=$(mktemp -d "$QUALIFICATION_ROOT/tamper-XXXXXX") && cp security/reports/adversarial-coverage/security-junit.xml "$w/results.xml" && printf '\n' >> "$w/results.xml" && python3 scripts/report_test_coverage.py --junit "$w/results.xml" --run security/reports/adversarial-coverage/test-run.json --output "$w/report"

stderr_contains: JUnit changed after the recorded run
